result['Median'] = result['Median'].astype(float)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Major_category (primary key)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Major_category", how="inner")

# Calculate mean Median per Major_category (group by Major_category)
result = joined.groupby("Major_category", as_index=False).agg({"Median": "mean"})

# Write output
